Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From English ping pong.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈpiŋˌpoŋ/, [ˈpiŋˌpo̞ŋ]
  • Rhymes: -oŋ
  • Syllabification(key): ping‧pong
  • Hyphenation(key): ping‧pong

Noun

[edit]

ping-pong (rare)

  1. synonym of pöytätennis (ping pong).
    ping-pong-diplomatia ― ping-pong diplomacy
